newsitem.title: USA: Emerson Electric names Tamke as president.
newsitem.headline: Emerson Electric names Tamke as president.

text.p: Emerson Electric Co said Monday it named George Tamke president and said he also will be elected a director.
Tamke succeeds Charles Knight in the president's position. Knight continues as chairman and chief executive officer.

Tamke, who joined the company in 1989 as an executive vice president for corporate technology, will be responsible for the operations of all Emerson's businesses, from process control to heating, ventilating and air-conditioning to industrial motors and drives; to motors and appliance components.
Emerson manufactures a broad range of electrical, electronic and related products.
